newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Eindhoven airport cargo rises 17 pct rise in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Eindhoven airport cargo rises 17 pct rise in 1996.

text.p: Eindhoven Airport experienced a rapid rise in freight volumes last year, when freight grew by 17 percent to 23,100 tons, an airport statement said.
In reality most of the freight was in fact trucked and only 235 tons of humanitarian aid was actual airfreight.
Every night scheduled trucking services link the southern Dutch airport with ten other European airports, the statement said.

Eindhoven handled 255,000 passengers for the year which represented an increase of 21 percent on 1995 levels, when 211,000 passengers used the airport. Most of these, (79 percent) were using sceduled airlines. This was a growth of 19 percent on the year previously.
A dozen scheduled airlines operate from the airport and this includes the airport's latest arrival, Denim Air, which operates scheduled services to London City Airport.
This year Air Exel is expected to start a scheduled service to Hamburg. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
